value.rationale: This is the complete natural distribution of a polynomial bracket map across all its outputs, not an ad hoc field-sized slice or mere commuting count. It gives a uniform family-wide invariant with a geometric explanation of which output directions are enriched, spanning all finite fields including characteristic two and all Pfaffian root profiles. The exact fiber profile is not stated in the previously inspected classification, and could be used to distinguish arithmetic commutator statistics even when structural inputs are given.
